definitions.explanation: A human individual. The basic word for referring to people in general.
Used to refer to others in general. {人|ひと}に{言|い}う (to tell someone), {人|ひと}の{話|はなし} (what others say).
The nature or personality of a person. いい{人|ひと} (a good/kind person).

examples.english: There are a lot of people, aren't there?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}な→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧{人|ひと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many kind people in Japan.
When I see people reading books on the train, it makes me want to read too.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いてみよう→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
{人|ひと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にしないで→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: Don't worry about what others think.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけません→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
{人|ひと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's important to listen well to what others say.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧{人|ひと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I want to become someone who understands other people's feelings.
They're a good person, aren't they?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：00475_yasashii⟧{人|ひと}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{人|ひと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧{人|ひと}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: That person is an interesting person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{人|ひと}⟦だけど→だけど：00033_dakedo⟧、⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{人|ひと}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦にくい→〜にくい：02005_nikui⟧。
examples.english: He's a capable person, but he's a bit strict, so he's hard to talk to.

notes:
{人|ひと} is the basic word for "person" or "people." One of the most fundamental vocabulary items.

PRONUNCIATION:
- ひと: standalone word
- じん: nationality/type suffix (⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧, ⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧)
- にん: counter for people (⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask someone
- {人|ひと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: what others say
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{人|ひと}: a good/kind person
- {人|ひと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: crowded (many people)

SENSE 2 - "OTHER PEOPLE":
When {人|ひと} means "others" rather than "a person," it often carries a mild reproach: {人|ひと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (without any thought for how I feel), {人|ひと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to speak ill of others), {人|ひと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a fool of someone). Learners often read these as a neutral "people" and miss the complaint.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人|ひと} vs. ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧: {人|ひと} is the everyday word; ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧ is "human being" as a species or as a moral character (⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧, "humane")
- {人|ひと} vs. ⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧: the plural form refers to people collectively, as in a crowd or a population
- {人|ひと} vs. ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ is the polite word for a person; use it when speaking about customers, guests, or anyone deserving respect (⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧, not ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{人|ひと}, in formal speech)
- {人|ひと} vs. ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ is formal or written, and is also the humble word for oneself and one's own group

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {人|ひと}⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧: different for each person
- ⟦{十人十色|じゅうにんといろ}→十人十色：04770_juunintoiro⟧: different strokes for different folks
